create_bilstm_config: create a BiLSTM Config with custom dropout, lstm_dim, num_layers, and bidirectional settings
build_bilstm_representation: build a BiLSTM representation layer with a given config, embed_dim, and padding value
run_bilstm_forward: run the BiLSTM forward pass on embedded tokens with sequence lengths and optional states
review_bilstm_forward: review the BiLSTM forward method for pack_padded_sequence and pad_packed_sequence handling
test_bilstm_jit_tracing: test the BiLSTM forward pass with torch.jit tracing and disable_sort_in_jit enabled
